basis.tokenizer: tiktoken cl100k_base, a proxy: Claude's tokenizer counts differently
basis.schema: one tool = compact JSON of {name, description, inputSchema}, the serialization capture_schema_baseline.py uses; a tool's tokens are counted on its own row
basis.deferred_names: each deferred tool as mcp__jcodemunch__<name>, newline-joined, counted once; the prefix is what a deferring client shows the model
basis.instructions: server._mcp_instructions(surface) with no repository context, counted once; a live session names its indexed file count, which can move this by a few tokens
basis.deferring_total: schemas of always-loaded tools + deferred_names + instructions
basis.non_deferring_total: schemas of every published tool + instructions
basis.config: the default config (empty CODE_INDEX_PATH), tool_profile full, compact_schemas default
basis.excludes: the client's own tool-search wrapper and any per-request framing around a schema
